question: How many real RV campgrounds do the STATE agencies have that campgrounds.json does not?
method: audit/state_gap_portal.py against each agency's own US eDirect booking portal, matched at FACILITY level; every camping facility not held judged by hand

verdicts.Muskingum River SP / Ellis Lock #11 Camp: NOT a miss - already held as entry 1018 'Muskingum River Parkway State Park (Ellis Lock 11)'. The portal pins the PARK at its Dillon Hills Drive office 35 km away, so a distance-only match reported an entry we have had all along. This is what forced facility-level matching
verdicts.Independence Dam SP: no - tent-only, 25 non-electric primitive sites; its hike/bike-in campground likewise
verdicts.Sycamore SP: no - equestrian camp and group camp only

OH.also_checked_by_hand: ODNR Division of Forestry campgrounds are FCFS and absent from ReserveOhio: Fernwood and Harrison are already held; Shawnee, Tar Hollow, Vinton Furnace and Zaleski are horse or hunter camps

verdicts.Lafayette Blue Springs SP: no - walk-in tent sites only, no RV access; cabins and group/pavilions besides
verdicts.Long Key SP: no - RV camping lost to Irma/Ian with no plan to rebuild; 4 hike-in tent sites, closed for construction since 2026-07-12

FL.caveat: the other 100 unmatched are museums, springs, preserves, historic sites and fishing piers. Florida Forest Service campgrounds are NOT in this portal and were not checked here; 28 FL entries already mention forest/WMA

verdicts.Cloquet Valley SF / Indian Lake Campgrou: MISS - 25 drive-in sites, a loop with water hookups for RVs, boat ramp, vault toilets, reservable, May-Oct
verdicts.Paul Bunyan SF / Gulch Lake Campground: MISS - 9 primitive drive-in sites plus a group site, FCFS; same class as Mantrap Lake in the same forest, which we already hold
verdicts.John A. Latsch SP: no - day-use only, its 7 hiker sites closed
verdicts.Afton / Glendalough / Lake Maria / Georg: no - backpack, hike-in, cart-in, canoe-in, group and camper-cabin only
verdicts.Finland SF group campground: no - group only; Finland Campground itself is already held

MN.note: MN state forest rows carry 0,0 coordinates in the portal, so they can never match on distance and always surface as unmatched

result.conclusion: Far below the 8% single data point the remaining-work map extrapolated from, and far below the federal gap's 334 known rows. The state face of the non-RV-Life gap is NOT the next priority.
result.correction: First reported as 3 misses / 1.3%. Ellis Lock #11 was already held as entry 1018 and was a false positive of park-level distance matching; the tool now matches facility by facility and names a possible existing entry rather than hiding or inventing one.

pattern: Misses cluster OUTSIDE the flagship reservable park system: SD's were Lakeside Use Areas, MN's were both state forests, OH's was a river-lock parkway campground. The flagship state park systems are essentially fully covered.
